parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description: The name of the application to which the stream belongs.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The order in which entries are sorted by creation time. Valid values:
- **asc** (default): ascending order.
- **desc**: descending order.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: **10**. Valid values: **5 to 30**.
